rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the warriors just named
compound of karaṅka and pramukha, 'led by Karanka'
adjective modifying sarpiṇyā in instrumental singular feminine
past participle of yu, 'joined or endowed'

items.question: Are Karanka and the others endowed with the unfailing serpent-woman?
items.inference: The named warriors possess the unfailing serpent-woman.
uncertainties: Exact identity and role of sarpiṇī remain unclear.
items.plain_english: These, headed by Karanka, are endowed with the unfailing serpent-woman.
